label: preparing
what: A surprise anniversary/jubilee supper for the mayor, day 1 at 18:00 in the town hall great hall, with bread and lantern lighting. The mayor knew and approved the civic supper but was not told its anniversary purpose. Innkeeper, freight, builder and baker explicitly describe the confidential purpose and coordinated funding, ingredients, baking, lighting and delivery. Secretary knowingly helped the supper arrangements and escort, but the record does not establish that secretary knew the anniversary secret; likewise neighbour and watchman knew only ordinary supper arrangements.
